production_entrypoints.production_role: formal initialization planner and readiness index
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Use as the owner of the formal initialization plan; subordinate tools handle read-only COM or controlled writes.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not start initialization from ad hoc root scripts, _handoff evidence, or V1/V2 launchers.
production_entrypoints.notes: Owns SN/device_code, protocol ID alias, runtime, GETCO, neutralization, S9, CHECK, and pre-gas evidence contracts.

production_entrypoints.production_role: manual-authorized read-only identity, SN, GETCO, runtime, and CHECK-capable evidence
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Requires packet validator, reviewed ports, active analyzer list, authorization packet, >=1s pacing, no-write/no-db/no-route confirmation.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not use raw serial scripts as production identity evidence.
production_entrypoints.notes: Legacy analyzers must not receive CHECK; new-algorithm/CHECK-capable analyzers may read CHECK only after the read-only plan allows it.

production_entrypoints.point_contract: PACE INL absolute pressure, S9 no-write first
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Pressure reference and route-independent pressure evidence must be ready; writes remain separate controlled steps.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not use the wrong PACE pressure query or CO2/H2O route data as pressure readiness.
production_entrypoints.notes: Linear S9 exceptions must be explicit controlled exceptions with write/readback/reverify evidence.

production_entrypoints.production_role: mature legacy CO2 open-flow production queue
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Pre-gas readiness, pressure/S9, route readiness, dewpoint/source readiness, and mature 0620/0621 physical conditions must be closed.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not use root migration runners, 0624 handoff queues, diagnostic probes, or _handoff scripts.
production_entrypoints.notes: Single-analyzer ratio instability should degrade analyzer/point quality; public physical gates decide point-level failure.

production_entrypoints.production_role: mature legacy H2O open-flow production queue
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: CO2 route evidence, pressure readiness, humidity-generator readiness, dewpoint/reference evidence, and mature 0620/0621 route behavior must be closed.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not use 0624 handoff H2O queue or migrated root queue as the mature baseline.
production_entrypoints.notes: CO2 zero gas and H2O dry/low-water anchor evidence remain physically separate.

production_entrypoints.production_role: offline candidate coefficient calculation and fit review
production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Use 0613-style fitting and keep rejected/superseded/diagnostic evidence out of formal fit eligibility unless explicitly reviewed.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not use V1 old fitting shortcuts, smoke points, or diagnostic rows as production fit data.
production_entrypoints.notes: S1/S3 and S2/S4 are main chains; S5/S6 are final linear layers handled as separate review/write decisions.

production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Requires old GETCO snapshot, candidate review, explicit authorization, exact payload formatting, readback, and short reverify.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not run controlled-write tools as background evidence, replay, or report steps.
production_entrypoints.notes: SENCO5 writes must compose with current GETCO5 and prefer CLEARSENCO5,YGAS,FFF before writing the final layer.

production_entrypoints.required_before_use: Archive closure, SN traceability, readback, reverify, PostgreSQL 18 dry-run/import gates, and reviewer authorization remain separate gates.
production_entrypoints.forbidden_substitutes: Do not treat status rollups, dry-run database contracts, or no-write math as real release/import evidence.
production_entrypoints.notes: This map does not allow release or database import.

forbidden_surfaces.examples: _handoff/*, ad hoc run folders, copied evidence bundles
forbidden_surfaces.reason: Evidence and scratch artifacts can explain a decision, but must not be used as executable production entrypoints.

forbidden_surfaces.examples: root-level migrated runners, temporary queue experiments, 0624 handoff logic
forbidden_surfaces.reason: The current production baseline is the 0613 fitting method plus 0620/0621 mature physical path, not later migration drafts.

forbidden_surfaces.examples: dynamic pressure diagnostics, no-OUTP probes, sealed-pressure tuning, extended hold experiments
forbidden_surfaces.reason: Diagnostic rows may explain physics, but are not production fit or release evidence unless separately reviewed.
Workers must be called by canonical CO2/H2O queue runners so point order, route setup, and evidence indexing stay coherent.

forbidden_surfaces.examples: run_v1_*, V2 device workbench, V2 engineering probes
forbidden_surfaces.reason: V1 is historical/fallback reference and V2 remains outside V1.5 production entrypoint control.

checks.requirement: Legacy CO2 production entry must remain the mature 45-point queue.
Legacy H2O production entry must remain the mature 13 wet-point queue.
Sampling workers must not be top-level production launchers.
Root migration and 0624 handoff areas must not be treated as mature V1.5 baseline.
Coefficient writes are only manual-authorized controlled-write surfaces with readback/reverify.
This entrypoint map is offline documentation and must not grant release, import, COM, route, pressure, or write actions.
